title: Apply newly uploaded images as canonical public assets (bg.png, vinyl.png, bodyhdd.png, disk.png, arm.png)

requirements.text: Add the 5 newly uploaded images to the project’s frontend public static assets and set them as the canonical filenames used by the app: place bg-3.png as frontend/public/bg.png, vinyl-3.png as frontend/public/vinyl.png, bodyhdd-3.png as frontend/public/bodyhdd.png, disk-3.png as frontend/public/disk.png, and arm-3.png as frontend/public/arm.png.

quotes: The user has uploaded 5 image(s): bg-3.png, arm-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png.

acceptanceCriteria: The files frontend/public/bg.png, frontend/public/vinyl.png, frontend/public/bodyhdd.png, frontend/public/disk.png, and frontend/public/arm.png exist in the repository and are the newly uploaded images (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png respectively).
On a fresh load, the background, vinyl image, and HDD hub layers render the real uploaded visuals (not the SVG placeholders), assuming the canonical files exist.

requirements.text: Preserve the originally uploaded filenames (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png) in the repository in addition to the canonical copies, so the original uploads remain available for reference.

quotes: The user has uploaded 5 image(s): bg-3.png, arm-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png.

acceptanceCriteria: The repository contains copies of the original uploaded assets using their original filenames (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png) in a non-conflicting public-accessible location (e.g., under frontend/public/assets/uploads/ or similar).
The live app continues to reference only the canonical filenames (bg.png, vinyl.png, bodyhdd.png, disk.png, arm.png) via the existing asset URL resolver; no code changes are required for references.

constraints: Frontend must continue to use the existing base-path-safe asset resolution (import.meta.env.BASE_URL) and the existing fallback chains; do not reintroduce root-absolute "/..." asset paths.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change HDDHub geometry, rotation mapping, overlay behavior, category data, or audio behavior as part of this task.
Do not implement custom domain/subdomain configuration (e.g., shibhii.caffeine.xyz) in this change.
